title: Uniform halting bound
statement: Let a nondeterministic register program with oracle, input, and guard be fixed, and let $a$ be a configuration from which every branch terminates while satisfying the guard at each live intermediate configuration. Then there is a natural number $N$ such that every choice string of length $N$ leads from $a$ to a halted configuration, and for every shorter prefix of such a string, if the resulting configuration is still live then it satisfies the guard.
hypotheses_covered: the initial configuration has the inductively defined termination property: halted configurations terminate, and at each live guarded configuration both choice successors terminate
